summary: Bound the AI coordinator's 20 Hz tick. GameAiCoordinatorHost owns the group think and the planners, answers both reconstructed host interfaces from the mission's units, and installs the planner's attack decision on each member as a scene command through the same 0046AAB0 -> 0077D600 path a scripted order takes. The coordinator runs on all three missions and changes the outcome of all three.
ghidra_writes: none. Read-only analysis; one existing ledger name gained appended evidence.
blocked: The fixed-step hook lives in src/game_hosts_units.cpp, which the torpedo worker holds. It is NOT in this commit. The five-line contract is in docs/AI_COORDINATOR_TICK.md and was applied locally only to take the measurements below.

step1_findings: The coordinator is created at mission load: 00A32350 BSP_AiController_Create has exactly two callers, 004E1838 inside BSP_Game_LoadMissionScene and 00A373AF inside the Lua binding BSP_LuaBinding_AICreate. Its constructor 00A31730 installs vtable 00D23168 on the node at coordinator+170h and registers it into fixed-step group 0 at 00A31766.

The 00F8AA60/00F8AA64 list needs no separate filler: it is element 2 of g_aiGroupsByTeam at 00F8AA48 (stride 0Ch), and BSP_AiGroup_Construct appends every group to g_aiGroupsByTeam[group+5638h] at 00A2E086-00A2E0BD. The host reproduces that append inside create_group, so the proximity list fills itself.

The party gate 009FFE50 is the binding constraint, not a missing input. In game modes 0 to 3 only party slots 0 and 4 are AI-enabled. All three missions carry sides 0, 1 and 2; only side 0 gets a brain. The enemy sides are never planned for, and that is the shipped rule, not a gap in this host.

The tuning block 00A371A0 is loaded by 00A335D0, reached only from CG_array_ctor_helper_00a37130 and BSP_AiGlobals_Reload. No AI globals script runs in this process, so every tuning field is zero and both merge phases take nothing.

ijn01.attribution: This is the uncommanded-aircraft mission. The headline is the plane motion pass: yaw_plans nearly doubled, 3000 to 5904, pose_rotations 3625 to 8504 and heading_change 3.862 to 8.881 rad. The aircraft no longer fly straight. free_flight is unchanged at 99000 because that counter is 007CE040's flight-model arm selection (free flight against ground roll and surface), not a task test, so it cannot move for an airborne plane. The pilot attack table went from 2 ordered units to 4. Tokens: 75 artillery, which the 26-row registry's first-match walk resolved to attackmove, and 4 dogfight. Gunnery damage is unchanged; one attack order in 150 s is not enough to change the shooting.

usn01.attribution: The largest outcome change of the three. Ordered units went 5 to 14, hits 23 to 62, deaths 1 to 2 and damage 220.0 to 3518.9, a factor of sixteen, all from 24 member commands issued at 4.85 s. Shots fell 8711 to 3476 while hits rose, so the aircraft are being aimed rather than firing at nothing. closed_mean went negative, which says the newly ordered units are opening range on their targets rather than closing: the order reaches them but the approach is not solved, and that belongs to the plane task machinery, not to the coordinator.

usn02.attribution: 14 ship commands at 4.85 s. Hits rose 126 to 168 and damage 13673.7 to 19723.2 on a third fewer shots, and the first hit moved 10 seconds earlier, 41.85 s to 31.90 s: the ordered ships close on their target instead of idling. The ship AI standoff census nearly doubled, 8400 to 15953 choices and 2450 to 4660 curve refreshes, which is the ring arm running for ships that now have somewhere to be. Deaths are unchanged at 3.

uncertainties: One attack order per mission. The party think fires 39 times but claims one group and issues once, because a group already on its target returns early at 00A2CBD0's second test and this process never clears the command. The native clear happens through the AI command's own lifetime, which is unread.
can_auto_merge answers false and auto_merge_dist answers 0, so neither merge phase ever takes a merge. Both depend on the AI command object and on the tuning block, and neither exists here.
Groups are filed under a party equal to their team. The native party slot is a separate field; nothing in this process produces one.
The seed pass yields one group per team because only collection 0 is populated. The native five collections would seed up to five.
game_mode is 0 by substitution. A different mode would change both the party gate and ai_party_think_mode's GroupWalk answer.
artillery resolves to attackmove through the registry's first-match walk. That is the recovered 0046AAB0 behaviour as this process implements it, reported as observed and not explained here.
